_comment: Settings for experiments/batch_runner.py and experiments/plan.py. Prices are integers in ZUP derived from each case's budget B (預算金額): cost C = round(B * cost_ratio), seller opening offer O = round(B * offer_ratio), buyer funds = round(B * buyer_funds_multiple). price_structures are PLACEHOLDERS (pilot ratios: wide 40/60/50, narrow 40/45/50, no_range 60/40/65) until agreed with the advisor. case_context templates are DRAFTS; the wording is the researcher's to decide.

case_context.zh: 本局情境：物品 X 代表一批「{category}」，數量 {quantity}，以整批方式交易（X: 1 即整批）。
case_context.en: Scenario: the item X in this game stands for one lot of {category}, quantity {quantity}, traded as a single lot (X: 1 is the whole lot).
